policies.title: Nigerien ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Niger as Prior to Arrival, which it defines as obtaining a visa from a mission or consulate before travel.
conditions: Applies to a Nigerien ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a mission or consulate before travel.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Nigerien ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule places Niger in its authorized-visa cohort for advance consular approval.
conditions: Applies to a Nigerien ordinary passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
The cited Embassy says authorized-visa approval may take up to 60 business days; applicants must confirm the procedure with their competent Panamanian consulate before travel.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.
